page.layout: Printed page 16 on the scan. Top: page number at upper left, then a decorative ornament band (not text). Then a title block, centred: "ODE MONOCOLOS." and "DE STRAGE CLASSIS Hispanicæ.", followed by a dedication line "AD SERENISS. ELIZAB. Angliæ Reginam." One column of verse below, opening with a woodcut initial. Catchword at lower right. No margin notes. Right edge shows show-through from the facing page, not transcribed.

l.i: Dum nunc Christicolæ sedibus à suis
Mæsta voce DEVM non tepide precans
Et circumreflui qui salis es potens:
Isti, qui reliquis Solis in ædibus,

page.notes: Short lines are set as verse; the poem is one stanza, so it is one paragraph. Italic is read from the scan: lines "Quæ nunc ... domus," and "Vt pulchræ" to "inuident," look slanted; "In pœnas hominum vindice Numine)" and "Turritis pelagus classibus obtegi," look roman, so their italic status is uncertain. "hospitis" and "Ibericæ" are read from a small, soft print: possible [?] readings. "votaque votaque" is printed as such (repetition kept). The catchword "Arctoa" at lower right is the start of the next page.
